items.title: Modern Base
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Find your adventure in the Modern Base world and finish jump and runs to get some start items. Perfect for your roleplay with your friends.

- Jump and run
- Roleplay
- Modern base

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Taiga Village
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Explore the Taiga Village and find new traders to deal with. Great for roleplaying with your friends in a fantastic world.

- Roleplay
- Trading
- Village
- Boat

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Free Style
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Do you have a open and free mind? Choose any of these skins for your next Minecraft adventure!

- Perfect for role-playing, PvP, and PvE
- Cute
- Colorful
- Modern

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Among Demons
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
The colorful demons are among us! They are fresh and super cool, they are perfect for playing Whodunit mystery and for finding the imposter. Now you and your friends can use matching fashionable skins when you team up to catch the hidden impostor.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Ninja Assassins
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Move carefully and silently in your ninja uniform, you have a job to do! Role-play as a sly killer, only letting them see your eyes, if they see you at all. Pick from lots of secret spy skins that make working in the shadows easy. Don’t let anyone stop you from completing your super important mission.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Hacker Police
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
If you want to beat the bad guys, join them. Create a police squad of hackers to track down crime and bring justice. Choose from 8 different skins and use all your tech tools to role-play as clever cops and enforce the law. 

1 free skin included!

items.title: Masked Anime Animals
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Want to hide your identity but in style? Dress up as your favorite animals with bright outfits great for blending in a survival server with friends or doing roleplay. Perfect for the anime and animal lovers who love to stand out from the crowd but keep their face a secret.
+ 11 masked anime skins

items.title: Anime Academia
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Do you want to go to the anime academy? This is your chance! Explore the brand new, famous Anime Academia skins!

+Includes 9 anime skins
+By Blockarts

items.title: Become A Builder
items.creator: MrAniman2
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to build great builds and impress friends with your building skills? Well, now is your chance to learn to build like a pro! 

This building tutorial will guide you on how to create 8 stunning builds.

- Toggleable Flame particle system to guide you
- Build in Creative or Survival mode
- 8 beautiful buildings 
- Single & multiplayer
- One skin

items.title: Kings and Queens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
With these 12 skins fit for royalty, the throne is yours to take. Show off your power and vast riches with these amazing royal skins.
Become the king or queen you always wanted to be!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Animal Cops & Robbers
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Will you help and protect the animals by joining the Animal Police Force or will you give in to the temptation of the exhilarating thrill of wealth and adventure by joining the robbers? The choice is yours to make!

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Zeus Paradise
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The god of the sky and thunder has invited you to his realm! Do you dare to enter the kingdom of the skies and join the king of the gods?

- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Wizard's Castle
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
In the days of the good king, the castles made peace with one another. We traded goods and inter-marriage was normal. In that, we grew stronger and the golden age began, the days of the rise of magic. Explore the castle of the old and mighty wizards, but be careful of the great challenges that come with learning the ancient powers.

- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Kingdom Conquerors
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Conquer the kingdom in style with the Kingdom Conquerors skin pack!

+ 10 medieval-themed skins
+ Roleplay ready
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Amateurs
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you an amateur? Well, look the part! You can make it one day, maybe.

+ 10 amateur roleplay skins
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: New Day
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
New day, new me! Or was that supposed to be for the new year? Whatever. Today, we start fresh! 

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Casual modern attire inspired by fashion trends!

items.title: Tiny Fantasy 2 Skins
items.creator: BDcraft
items.description:
20 HD skins: 5 tiny characters each available in 4 variants + 2 free rats!

In a world of giants, trolls and dragons, we also find brave and valiant little folks!

Meet the tinies: Tiny Knight, Fired Peon, Tiny Ripper, Evil Knight, Slimy Fungus + 2 free rats!

Made with love by BDcraft

items.title: Tiny Fantasy 1: Girls Skins
items.creator: BDcraft
items.description:
20 HD skins: 5 tiny characters each available in 4 variants + 2 free rats!

In a world of giants, trolls and dragons, we also find brave and valiant little folks!

Meet the tinies: Tiny Princess, Goblin Waitress, Tiny Riding Hood, Evil Princess, Tiny Dragon + 2 free rats!

Made with love by BDcraft

items.title: Biome Fashion
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Feel right at home in your favorite biome! From the Nether to the ocean to the End, journey in style!

- 10 trendy teen skins!
- Licensed by The Pocalypse Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Neon Geos
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Break out some intense colors with the Neon Geos skin set! Bright and vivid abstract designs to perfectly represent your style!

- 8 unique geometric skins!
- Cool and unique patterns
- Wide variety of colors to choose from!

items.title: Animatronics
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
The lights are flickering... and I think I just saw that bear move! Watch out, these animatronic skins are scary, especially at night!

- 8 terrifying skins!
- Five unique bears and various other animal designs!

items.title: Runners Vs. Hunters
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Put on your sneakers and masterfully speedrun to the end! Or, gear up for the hunt and stop those runners in their tracks!

- Six high-speed HD skins
- Licensed by The Pocalypse Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Fiesta
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description:
It's party time! Bright and vibrant skins inspired by the multiple Spanish fiestas during the year.
- 6 Bright and colourful skins
- Perfect for virtual in-game fiestas

items.title: Rainbow Geometry
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Blast out in color with the Rainbow Geometry skin set! Colorful abstract designs to illuminate your world!

- 8 unique rainbow skins!
- Cool geometric patterns
- Cool color gradients!
